    "Customer mailed a check for their Discover credit card payment on time.",
    "Customer's checkbook contains an entry for the payment and a carbon copy of the check.",
    "Discover claims they never received the payment.",
    "Customer has a 20-year history of on-time payments.",
    "Customer is paying electronically and verifying each payment via phone call."

  "unknowns": [
    "Check's tracking number or proof of mailing.",
    "Date the check was mailed.",
    "Date the payment was due.",
    "Date Discover claims they received the letter from the customer."

  "recommended_routing": "Card Billing Disputes",
  "human_review_required": true,
  "rationale": "Customer's history of on-time payments and verification of electronic payments suggest a legitimate dispute, but human review is needed to investigate the lost payment claim."
}
